citation.title: Effect of single-nanosized oxygen nanobubble water intake on lactate threshold during incremental exercise: a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled crossover trial

reported.what: heart rate at peak exercise, placebo-water arm, mean (SD), n = 20 (Table 3, column Placebo water)

location.where: Table 3, Peak, row HR, bpm, placebo column

reported.what: blood lactate at the end of the incremental test and 2.5 and 5 min after it, placebo-water arm, mean (SD), n = 20 (Table 4, column Placebo water)

location.where: Table 4, Lactate (mM), placebo column, rows Post, After 2.5 min, After 5 min

reported.what: work rate at lactate threshold, placebo-water arm, mean (SD), n = 20 (Table 2)

location.where: Table 2, Work rate at LT, placebo column

detail: The only arm the model can run is the placebo-water arm, but its bout is a ramp to symptom-limited exhaustion (20 W warm-up for 120 s, then 10, 15 or 20 W added every 60 s by each participant's fitness, 'approximately 10 min'), whose per-participant step, length and end minute are not printed, so no activity level or fixed post-exercise sampling minute can be written; the resting values (heart rate 70.4 (11.2) bpm, Table 3) were taken after at least 3 h without food of an undescribed last meal, after stretching and warm-up, so they are not a fasting sample either.
